body:
Jahanzaib ki request par VPS par check karo ke n8n (n8n.aijahan.cloud) kis tarah install hai — npm se ya Docker se. Reason: n8n 3.0 is October me aa raha hai aur us me npm/npx installs khatam ho rahe hain; Docker Compose hi supported self-host path reh jayega.

Ye commands chalao aur output report karo:
1) docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Image}}' | grep -i n8n
2) which n8n; npm ls -g --depth=0 2>/dev/null | grep -i n8n
3) n8n --version

Agar n8n Docker se chal raha hai: sirf version confirm karke report kar do, kaam khatam.

Agar npm install nikle: foran ye plan banao (abhi migration mat karo, sirf plan + backup):
- pehle credentials + execution data ka backup lo (n8n data dir ki safe copy)
- Docker Compose par migrate karne ka step-by-step plan banao — reference: https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n-docs/blob/HEAD/docs/changelog/v30-breaking-changes.md
- migration kab karni chahiye (October release se pehle) ye bhi tajweez do.

Reply muse-inbox/muse-20261002-n8ncheck-result.json me do: install method, n8n version, aur agar npm hai to backup status + migration plan. Jahanzaib ko report karna hai ke unka n8n 3.0 ke liye safe hai ya nahi.
title: n8n install method check: npm ya Docker? + 3.0 migration plan
